data.narrative:
Askari Defense operates in the Defense & Security sector at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of two public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private competitors, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. The broader sector encompasses 24 firms, though few directly align on stage and valuation tier.

The peer-median method is not applicable here. Despite identifying 24 same-sector peers, the analysis found zero comparables matching same-stage criteria, zero at adjacent stages, and zero within similar valuation tiers. A median derived from the full sector cohort would introduce unacceptable selection bias, as it would conflate companies at fundamentally different growth phases and scales. This gap reflects the specialized and segmented nature of frontier-tech defense markets, where stage and funding maturity create wide valuation dispersions.

Without sufficient narrow-set comparables, triangulated valuation cannot be reliably established from the data provided. A credible analysis would require either: (i) obtaining stage and recent valuation data for top private peers to construct a defensible peer set of minimum three firms, or (ii) employing alternative methods such as discounted cash flow or revenue multiples against disclosed financial performance. As currently constituted, the dataset does not support a quantitative valuation range for Askari Defense.
